$sources: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 87: the wind pressure = q Cf, q = 0.6 E V0² [N/m²]

MOC Notification No. 1454 of 2000: E = Er² Gf, Er = 1.7 (H/ZG)^α (H > Zb) or 1.7 (Zb/ZG)^α (H <= Zb), the terrain categories I-IV (Zb, ZG, α), Gf by the category and H, Cf = Cpe - Cpi (windward Cpe = 0.8 kz, leeward -0.4)
source: BSL Enforcement Order Art. 87 and MOC Notification 1454 for the main frame of closed buildings (the program's power law: the windward wall at Er(z)² Gf(H), the leeward at Er(H)² Gf(H); the cladding, internal pressure, roof and open structure coefficients remain the parent's until checked)

I.description: Terrain category I: flat sea-shore and lake-shore areas without obstructions, designated by the authority (Zb 5 m, ZG 250 m, α 0.10)

II.description: Terrain category II: flat land with few obstructions, outside categories I and IV (Zb 5 m, ZG 350 m, α 0.15)

III.description: Terrain category III: neither I, II nor IV (ordinary towns and suburbs; Zb 10 m, ZG 450 m, α 0.20)

IV.description: Terrain category IV: dense urban areas designated by the authority (Zb 20 m, ZG 550 m, α 0.27)

sources.exposures: MOC Notification 1454 Art. 1 (2): Er = 1.7 (max(z, Zb)/ZG)^α of the terrain categories I-IV (Zb 5, 5, 10, 20 m; ZG 250, 350, 450, 550 m; α 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.27), written as Kz = kzFactor (max(z, kzMinHeight)/zg)^(2/alpha) with alpha = 1/α and kzFactor = 1.7² × 0.6/0.613 = 2.8287 (the program's 0.000613 V² kN/m² carries the law's 0.6 V² N/m²); the windward pressure at height z, 0.6 Er(H)² Gf V0² × 0.8 kz with kz = (z/H)^(2α), is 0.6 Er(z)² Gf V0² × 0.8. Gf (Table of Notification 1454 Art. 1 (3)): H <= 10 m 2.0, 2.2, 2.5, 3.1; H >= 40 m 1.8, 2.0, 2.1, 2.3; linear between
sources.gust: Gf of category III at H <= 10 m where an exposure gives no points (all four do)
sources.directionality: The law has no directionality factor: 1.0
sources.topographic: Er of a site on a hill or escarpment (Notification 1454 Art. 1 (2) note) is not covered: 1.0
sources.cpWindward: MOC Notification 1454 Art. 3 (Table 1): Cpe = 0.8 kz on the windward wall of a closed building
sources.cpLeeward: MOC Notification 1454 Art. 3 (Table 1): Cpe = -0.4 on the leeward wall (all plan ratios)
